item.name: SPLOO Kids Gentle Shapeable Fruity Scent Soft Foam Bubbles Children Bath Shampoo Cleanser Fun Kids Bath 200ml
item.title: SPLOO Kids Gentle Shapeable Fruity Scent Soft Foam Bubbles Children Bath Shampoo Cleanser Fun Kids Bath 200ml
item.description:
[Description]

SPLOO Kids Foam Soap – Sculptable Bubble Fun! 🛁

🎨 Available in 3 Colours & Scents:
💗 Pink (Peach Scent) | 💙 Blue (Blueberry Scent) | 💛 Yellow (Pineapple Scent)

✅ Suitable for Ages 2 & Up

[SPLOO Highlights]

🫧 Rich, Dense & Shapeable Foam : Sculpt, squish, and play!

🚫 No Harsh Stuff : 
Free from Sulfates, Parabens, Alcohol & more

👶 Gentle on Skin :
Amino acid-based, safe for face & body. Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers & all bubble-loving kids! 

🌸 Long-Lasting Fruity Scent :
Sweet peach / Blueberry /Pineapple

💧 Skin-Softening Formula :
With Hibiscus Esculentus Fruit & Panthenol for daily hydration

🇰🇷 Formulated in Korea 

[Volume]

200ml

[How to Use]

1. Gently remove the safety cap before use and shake well
2. Spray into the air for 5 seconds to release excess gas
3. Hold upright and spray onto hand or skin - let the sculpting fun begin! 🤩
4. Rinse off completely with lukewarm water

SPLOO Tips:
For easy shaping,keep hands dry. Wet hands will make shaping difficult

🫧 SPLOO Play Tip! 
Make bath time more than just bubbles, make it a mini masterpiece moment! 

Before rinsing off, encourage your little one to shape the foam into silly beards, spiky hairdos, bubble crowns, or even pretend animals. It’s a great way to boost creativity and fine motor skills while having loads of fun. 

Don’t worry about the mess; everything rinses off clean and easy. Bonus tip: snap a photo of their funniest creation and start your own ‘SPLOO moment' 📸


[Ingredients]

Blue:
Water (Aqua), Butane, Isobutane, Glycerin, Propane, Stearic Acid, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Sorbitol, Lauric Acid, Olive Oil PEG-7 Esters, Phenoxyethanol, Hibiscus Esculentus Fruit Extract, Panthenol(B5), Fragrance (Parfum), Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose, Caprylyl Glycol, Disodium EDTA, FD&C Blue 1（CI 42090）

Pink:
Water (Aqua), Butane, Isobutane, Glycerin, Propane, Stearic Acid, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Sorbitol, Lauric Acid, Olive Oil PEG-7 Esters, Phenoxyethanol, Hibiscus Esculentus Fruit Extract, Panthenol(B5), Fragrance (Parfum), Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose, Caprylyl Glycol, Disodium EDTA, FD&C Red  33（CI 17200）

Yellow:
Water(Aqua),Butane,Isobutane,Glycerin,Propane,Stearic Acid,Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate,Sorbitol,Lauric Acid,Olive Oil PEG-7 Esters,Potassium Hydroxide,Phenoxyethanol,Hibiscus Esculentus Fruit Extract,Panthenol(B5),Fragrance (Parfum),Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose,Caprylyl Glycol,Disodium EDTA,FD&C Yellow 5(CI 19140),FD&C Red 40(CI 16035)

[Caution & Storage]

⚠️ Every child’s skin is a little different! Try a small amount on the arm first. If the skin gets red or itchy, stop using and check with a doctor. 
⚠️ For external use only
⚠️ Highly flammable – keep away from fire or heat
⚠️ Do not spray on face, eyes, ears, or wounds
⚠️ Use only in well-ventilated areas, maximum 20 minutes in enclosed spaces
⚠️ Adult supervision required
⚠️ Store below 40°C and away from direct sunlight

✅ KKM NOT
Pink- NOT250705383K
Blue- NOT250705382K
Yellow- NOT251103713K
